events.label: Launch
events.description: A vessel visibly lifts off the surface, or climbs under thrust close to the launch pad. Clear separation from the ground and a powered ascent are sufficient for a suggestion. Engine exhaust on a stationary craft, a menu or a loading screen is not launch.

events.label: Destructive explosion
events.description: A visible explosion destroys a vessel or its parts. Require destructive blast or breakup evidence. Normal engine exhaust, planned staging, smoke alone, and a scene transition do not establish destruction.

events.label: Landing
events.description: A vessel visibly touches down or rests intact in clear contact with terrain after flight. Stable surface contact is sufficient for a landing suggestion; the operator confirms whether it is new. Low altitude alone, menus and map icons are not landing.

events.label: Spacewalk / EVA
events.description: A recognizable suited Kerbal is visibly outside the vessel in the flight world view. A clear outside Kerbal is sufficient for an EVA suggestion; the operator confirms whether it is new. Portraits, editor previews and menu text are not EVA evidence.

events.label: Flag planting
events.description: A recognizable planted flag stands on terrain near a Kerbal, or visible flag planting occurs. A clear planted flag is sufficient for a suggestion; the operator confirms whether it is new. Map markers, menu icons and decorative flags are not evidence.

events.label: Parachute deployment
events.description: A clearly open or opening parachute canopy is attached to the vessel or Kerbal by suspension lines. Visible deployment is sufficient for a suggestion; the operator confirms whether it is new. Packed parts, icons and staging indicators are not evidence.
